summary: Brightwood Capital Corporation I filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a routine quarterly distribution of $0.29 per share on its common stock, payable September 15, 2026, to shareholders of record September 1, 2026. The distribution was declared by the board on August 28, 2026, and no other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report for a regulated investment company (BDC) and does not constitute a special situation such as a tender, merger, or capital return program. Watch for nothing; no risk-arb angle.
